Ben Fatto is looking for Senior QA who wants to work in international Scrum teams with a global leading-market software, in an environment of continuous professional development and teamworking.
 Requirements
 Minimum Requirements:

• At least 3 years of experience in the QA/testing area and at least 2 years of experience with automation.

• Experience in test automation engineering with selenium test tools (preferable in C#), postman , cypress and jmeter. Experience testing cross-browser and cross-device web applications using automated testing tools.

• Proficiency in developing, consuming and testing REST APIs, including documentation tools (Swagger/Postman). Proficiency in developing responsive first page/single page applications using javaScriptExperiences modular in test data persistence systems using SQL and NoSQL DBMS. [MSSQL, Post-Lasql, Dynamo].

• Good communication and collaboration skills.

• Conversational English.

 Additional (but not required) skills:

• Experience in AngularApplication, Performance, Management Kibana, Power BI, Tableu, Qicksight QWS, Cloud development experience, Plus data, Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence.

• Knowledge in pipeline execution processes.

 Originally posted on Himalayas
